claim_text: For every canonical nonempty exact simple 3-CNF F, if G3_NO_BLOCKED_CLAUSE(F), G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE(F), NOT_HORN(F), G_AFF_NOT_COMPLETE_AFFINE_BUNDLE(F), and G5_SINGLE_LITERAL_RUP_IRREDUCIBLE(F), then the exact frozen USF R0 reducer performs zero transformations, returns F literally unchanged, executes exactly one controller cycle, performs no restart, and terminates STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT.

source_semantics_reviewed.R33_BCE: a clause/literal is blocked iff every clause containing the opposite literal gives a tautological resolvent; the universal is vacuously true when no opposite-polarity clause exists
source_semantics_reviewed.R33_BVE: fires on x iff both distinct_non_tautological_resolvent_count <= removed_parent_clause_count and measure(transformed) < measure(current)
source_semantics_reviewed.R34: on simple width-3 CNF, recognition requires every variable-triple group to be exactly a four-clause one-parity falsifying-assignment class
source_semantics_reviewed.R35B: proposal exists iff some single-literal strengthening has a UP-conflict receipt; proposal=None triggers a final unassumed UP check
source_semantics_reviewed.CONTROLLER: R33 stalled -> R34 not recognized -> R35B; if R35B is not UNSAT and after_rup hash equals after_r33 hash, controller returns STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT without restart

obligations.target: simple canonical nonempty exact 3-CNF has no empty clause, no unit, no tautology, no distinct-clause subsumption, is not 2CNF, and exact duplicates are absent
G3 implies every used variable occurs in both polarities
G3 is equivalent to first_blocked_clause(F)=None on the stated domain
G4_EXACT_NO_BVE_CANDIDATE excludes every BVE candidate under the exact frozen two-conjunct predicate
with all R33 transformations excluded, NOT_HORN and not-2CNF force unchanged STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE
G_AFF is exactly R34 nonrecognition on simple exact 3-CNF
G5 yields no proposal; initial and final unassumed UP cannot conflict on unchanged exact 3-CNF; R35B returns unchanged STALLED_RUP_CORE with zero strengthenings
L0-L6 compose to zero transformations, residual F unchanged, one cycle, no restart, STALLED_PORTFOLIO_FIXPOINT

linear_subclass_obligations.target: linearity and {7,8} polarity counts give exactly 56 distinct non-tautological resolvents per variable; 56>15 blocks BVE
linearity implies at most one clause per variable triple, so no complete four-clause affine bundle

under an R35B two-literal assumption on a source clause, only that source clause can become unit; after its third variable is assigned, every other clause still has at least two unassigned variables, so no conflict/cascade
15-regular exact 3-CNF has 5n clauses; {7,8} gives at least 7n positive occurrences, contradicting Horn's at-most-5n positive occurrences
the linear 15-regular {7,8}-signed subclass satisfies the main lemma premises, conditional on existence of such a formula
